pages.text: $(#FFD700)Wings of the Gods$()$(br2)Chest-slot flight item (Aerial material — no armor points). Craft early with feathers, leather, and string.$(br2)Uses the $(l:progression/gems)same gem upgrades$() as tools (cobble → colored gems → Universe Gem). Only the $(#55FFFF)display name and look$() change per tier.

pages.title: Flight modes
pages.text: $(#55FFFF)Tiers 1–2 · Cape$()$(br)Crow → Magpie. Slow fall and reduced fall damage — no elytra deploy.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Tiers 3–6 · Elytra$()$(br)Phantom → Scarlet Macaw. Glide; speed improves as you level.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Tiers 7–10 · Wings$()$(br)Dark Spix → Allay → $(#FFD700)Wings of the Gods$() (Angel). Look up to climb.$(br2)Stats: Glide, Resistance (air time), Turn Speed, Fly Height. Gain XP while airborne.
